title: Passage and Wreck
author: Silas Vasquez
blurb: Theo Nakamura, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
